description: The work products that carry the alignment metric, fixed before any run. A product scores 1 when it uses the CURRENT rule (or, for a verdict, when the verdict is correct for the code in the tree under the current rule), 0 when it does not, and is left out when it was not produced. 'exec' products are scored by scripts/code_outcome.py; 'label' products are scored by a named human in labels/<arm>/<run-id>.json.
